title: Templates: Override Shapes From the Admin With Liquid | Orchard Core
description:
The pages of an Orchard Core site are built from shapes, and the view files of a theme decide how each shape renders. Changing one of them means changing the theme itself.

The Templates module stores Liquid templates in the database of the site, under the name of a shape or one of its alternates. A template is written in the admin, and for each alternate Orchard Core tries a template before a view file with the same name.

In this video:
• Shapes, alternates and templates: how a template finds the shape it replaces
• Create a template that overrides how a blog post is listed
• Names and properties: what to override, and what the Liquid can use
• Find the shape behind a fragment with shape debug information
• Shortcuts in Content Types that open the right template
• Manage templates: search, rename and delete
• Move templates between sites with recipes and deployment plans
